_help: Question/decision ledger. kind: business_rule|technical|environment. status: OPEN|ANSWERED|NEEDS_FOLLOW_UP|RESOLVED|SUPERSEDED (SUPERSEDED needs superseded_by). Material questions need >= 2 interpretations. Answers are recorded only with `ba.py answer` (answers.jsonl); reference them by id in resolution.answer_refs. resolution.kind: AUTHORIZED_DECISION (needs an AUTHORIZED answer) | VERIFIED_EVIDENCE (claim ids; business rules need an AUTHORITATIVE_REQUIREMENT) | SUPPORTED_INFERENCE (never for material business rules; not for material questions at high/critical risk). Every decision point must be settled in resolution.decision_points. contradictions[].resolution: UNRESOLVED|RESOLVED_BY_AUTHORIZED_DECISION|RESOLVED_BY_EVIDENCE|NOT_A_CONTRADICTION. counterexamples[].handled: UNHANDLED|COVERED_BY_RULE|ADDED_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERION|FOLLOW_UP|NOT_MATERIAL. Set duplicate_of to a RESOLVED question id instead of re-asking a known topic.
